recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, low-key portrait of a male figure in a dark trench coat, set against a textured dark background. The color palette is heavily desaturated with a warm, sepia-bronze tint. A large, translucent initial is layered behind the subject, while the primary text is anchored at the bottom in a clean, spaced serif font.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a dark, atmospheric background
Translucent large-scale initial acting as a secondary background layer
Horizontal text bar at the bottom providing a structural base
Warm metallic highlights contrasting with deep shadows
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting on the face
Wide letter-spacing for the primary name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white collar of the shirt underneath the coat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face down to the hands clutching the lapel, then to the wide horizontal text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the left and right sides of the subject, creating a narrow vertical focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and muted brown (background and coat).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white (shirt collar and earring highlights).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the face and the dark environment.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the main name
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large background initial is set at 15-20% opacity with a subtle gradient
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and opacities.
graphicDevices: Vertical OBI strip on the left edge with dense informational text
Horizontal divider line separating name from title

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with elegant proportions.
Extreme contrast for a more fashion-forward look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a dark brown trench coat, centered, with a moody dark textured background. Use low-key lighting focused on the face and hands. Apply a desaturated sepia-bronze color grade. Leave the bottom 15% of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, 15% opacity serif initial 'M' in the top left background. At the bottom, add the artist name in a wide-tracked, uppercase serif font in a light bronze color. Place the album title to the right, separated by a thin vertical line or space.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette restricted to bronze, brown, and charcoal?
Is the text tracking wide enough to span the width of the subject?
Is the background initial subtle and behind the subject?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Specific Japanese text on the OBI strip
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sepia tone is consistent across the image
Verify the subject is centered with symmetrical negative space
Confirm the bottom text is perfectly horizontal
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Low-Key Lighting + Sepia-Bronze Grade + Wide-Tracked Serif Typography + Translucent Background Initial.
